title: Cognito Authentication
description: Use Amazon Cognito for user authentication with the AWSSDK.CognitoIdentityProvider package.

data.text: Amazon Cognito handles user sign-up, sign-in, and access control. The Cognito Identity Provider SDK lets you automate these flows from C# and integrate them with serverless or traditional ASP.NET Core apps.

data.title: Sign up a user with the Cognito Identity Provider
Sign in and return tokens
data.content: Use AdminInitiateAuth for server-side authentication or InitiateAuth for client-side flows.

data.title: Never Store Passwords
data.text: Cognito is the source of truth for user credentials. Your app should never persist or log passwords. Use the returned tokens to authorize API calls instead.

data.title: Add Cognito authentication to a serverless API
data.description: Require a Cognito authorizer for API Gateway routes.
steps: Create a Cognito User Pool and App Client
Sign up and confirm a test user
Create a Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway
Attach the authorizer to an API route
Call the route with the ID token in the Authorization header
data.expectedOutcome: Unauthenticated requests return 401 and authenticated requests return 200 with user data.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Cognito User Pools handle sign-up and sign-in
ID tokens identify users; access tokens authorize actions
Authorizers in API Gateway validate Cognito tokens
Serverless APIs can use Cognito without custom auth code
data.takeaway: Cognito removes the need to build and secure your own authentication system.
